text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d be glad to help with this lead source project.

I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. For this job, I can build a clean and organized list of 100 influencers in New York, USA, with the company name, website, email, phone number, and address formatted clearly and ready to use.

I’m very comfortable with lead research and data整理-style work that requires accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail. I understand that the quality of a lead list depends on having complete and reliable information, so I focus on making sure each entry is checked and structured properly before delivery.

One relevant project I completed was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home. I built customer segments from Shopify order exports based on recency, frequency, and spend, and fed them into the email tool. That work helped the top segment represent 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%.

For your project, I would approach the influencer list by researching each record carefully and organizing the data into a simple, usable format. I can also make sure the final list is easy to review, sort, and use for outreach. If needed, I can keep the data clean and standardized so the information is consistent across all 100 entries.

I take pride in delivering work that is accurate, well-structured, and easy to hand off. If you’d like someone who is detail-oriented and reliable, I’d be happy to support this project.
